input_references.role: Independent polygon boundary, restriction type, and effective interval for the temporary constrained area
Additional vessel type, size, and typical-speed attributes

metadata.goal: Analyze how vessels adjust their movements when navigating around the constrained area.
metadata.dataset_description: Paired normal and constrained trajectories for 44 vessels in an offshore west-Jutland corridor. The restriction geometry and effective interval are supplied as an independent supporting table.
metadata.source_note: Danish maritime geography is used as context; the visible trajectories and attributes are constructed derived data.

insight_list.insight: Most vessels bypass the constrained area along a consistent side and gradually rejoin the main traffic flow after passing it.

plot.title: Navigation Around a Constrained Area
plot.description: Join the independent constrained-area boundary with paired normal and constrained trajectories, then identify bypass side and rejoining geometry.

insight_list.question: How do vessels bypass and rejoin traffic around the constrained area?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Join the independent constrained-area boundary with paired normal and constrained trajectories, then identify bypass side and rejoining geometry.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv(dataset_path); area=pd.read_csv(user_dataset_path); print(area[['area_id','restriction_type','effective_start','effective_end']].drop_duplicates()); print(df.groupby(['scenario','trajectory_id']).size())

insight_list.insight: Most vessels begin changing their heading before reaching the constrained area, while the corresponding COG changes more gradually and realigns with heading after the main turn is completed.

plot.title: Heading and COG Through the Turn
plot.description: Use the independent boundary to locate the approach and align constrained tracks around their principal turn before comparing heading with COG progression.

insight_list.question: How do heading and COG change during constrained-area avoidance?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Use the independent boundary to locate the approach and align constrained tracks around their principal turn before comparing heading with COG progression.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv(dataset_path); area=pd.read_csv(user_dataset_path); df['gap']=abs((df.heading-df.cog+180)%360-180); print(area[['lat','lon']].describe()); print(df.groupby('scenario').gap.describe())

insight_list.insight: Faster-moving vessels tend to initiate their course adjustment farther from the constrained area, while slower vessels make comparable directional changes closer to its boundary.
